When Cameron Hamilton asked his AI assistant, HALIE, to connect a nursery camera, it turned it into a baby monitor unprompted, and when asked to automate business growth, it suggested meeting customers in person. In this GitHub Universe 2026 session, Cameron Hamilton, Creator of Alliance AI, explores how to make proactive AI agents dependable using three core architectures: anticipation, self-evolution, and metacognition. Learn how autonomous agents decide what to do next, refine their own tools, and run efficiently on cost-effective models alongside GitHub Copilot. Discover practical frameworks to build self-directing agents that earn more autonomy through measurable results while keeping humans in the loop.

author: GitHub
description:
What happens when a commercial open source company changes its license and alienates its contributors? In this clip from The GitHub Podcast, Linux Foundation data scientist Sam Boysel explains how defensive forking keeps open source communities empowered. Because commercial open source startups derive their core value from community participation, shifting toward source-available or non-permissive licenses carries real risks.
